title: Educational Centre Website
description: Sample website concept for presenting school information, programmes, announcements and contact details in a clear responsive interface.
objective: Demonstrate how a structured website can organize information for an educational organization while maintaining a responsive user experience.
steps: Planned the information architecture and main navigation.
Organized content into clear sections for programmes, information and contact details.
Designed responsive page layouts for different screen sizes.
Applied consistent typography, spacing and visual hierarchy.
Reviewed the interface for usability and content clarity.
results: Created a sample educational website structure that presents institutional information in an organized and user-friendly format.
